reviews.title: Bright RGB, Quiet Performance, Easy Install
reviews.comment:
I recently installed the Thermalright fans in my PC, and I’m honestly impressed. My temps dropped immediately, and the fans run smooth without pulling in a ton of dust. The RGB is bright, clean, and easy to sync with the rest of my setup. Installation was simple and straightforward.
My only complaint is that it didn’t include front hardware mounting screws, which would’ve made the setup perfect. But overall, these fans deliver great airflow, great looks, and great value. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Phillip Motorolla

reviews.title: Cool, Quiet, and Surprisingly Powerful for the Price
reviews.comment:
Upgrading cooling components is one of those things that seems minor until you actually feel the difference. I picked up this 5-pack of 120mm fans to improve airflow in my mid-tower build, and I was blown away—literally and figuratively—by how well these performed straight out of the box.
The packaging was neat and secure, and each fan felt solid and well-made. The matte finish and minimal branding gave them a clean, professional look that blends in nicely with any setup. Mounting them was simple, and the included screws worked without any fuss. No weird vibrations, no misaligned holes, just an easy install all around.
What really stood out to me was the airflow-to-noise ratio. These fans are impressively quiet, even when running at full speed. I’ve used more expensive fans in the past that made more noise while pushing less air. These keep my CPU and GPU temps stable, especially during longer gaming sessions and heavier workloads like video editing. The airflow feels strong without being turbulent, and there's no annoying humming or whirring.
Pros
Excellent airflow with whisper-quiet operation
Sturdy, well-built construction with clean aesthetics
Great value for a 5-pack
Easy to install with no alignment issues
Ideal for both intake and exhaust configurations

reviews.title: Beautiful RGB, decent airflow and quiet operation.
reviews.comment: These fans are a steal for the price. They work really good and move plenty of air, not to mention they look great! Do yourself a favor and stop overpaying for fans. Get to 5 pack of these and forget about fans for years!
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Cheap, Great Value, but Some Issue
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/B1bXH4Si9QL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/51DInbA5NEL._SY256.jpg They worked, installed all 5 to my case which fills in the gaps that I was looking for. Dropped my temps quite a bit, from 40 degrees on light load to dropping it to 30 to 35 degrees, gaming wise sits nicely around 49 to 55 degrees in temps. Runs at 900rpm which is normal when looking at bios, it's a bit noisy but that doesn't bother me that much. I placed 3 as intake at the bottom, and 2 exhaust up top to somewhat balance out the intake and exhaust.
One tricky thing is, since it is CW it tripped me up on installing, since these do not have the arrows to show airflow. I simply spun the fan and felt where the air was going. The lights themselves are nice, bright and doesn't seem off when in sync with the montech case fans and cpu fans.
My main gripe is that one fan LEDs does flickers and it hasn't been a full day since I installed them. At first it was only during the blue transition when running it on cycle mode after I put my computer to sleep. Then it started to flicker on red. So I checked the connection, still flickers, then decided to daisy chain the rgb plug that single fan to another fan and the flicker hasn't happened (hopefully this solved it). I know my PSU isn't the issue since it's 850W and my fan hub is new and the other fans from Thermalright aren't flickering either. But overall it is to be expected at this price, and the RGB is optional, but is still a bit of an annoyance that it happened to one fan within a day of installing it.
reviews.author: CJ

reviews.title: 2 year update!!!
reviews.comment: After two years these have not failed me! Took this picture today to give her a deep clean. Rgb still is very bright. Initial setup and connection was simple and easy. Keeps all my components cool and they have a very low noise level. Super reliable and would buy again!
